svg.aria-label: Your project folder on your computer goes through pdt deploy, which checks it, builds an image, shows the plan and monthly cost, asks, then creates a schedule, the job, secrets, logs, and storage for artifacts and state in your own AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure account, or in Windows Task Scheduler on a PC. pdt runs, logs, health, and gui read the results back to your computer.
